Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 1, Verse 26

“There Arjuna saw, standing in both armies, fathers, grandfathers, teachers, uncles, brothers, sons, grandsons, friends, fathers-in-law, and well-wishers.”

The scene pulls back to reveal the full horror of Arjuna's situation — this isn't a war against strangers, but against nearly every close relation in his life, on both sides of the field.
